liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Reviewer likes the Dark Star but reports terrible feedback during its first fifteen minutes; Reviewer calls the Dark Star fantastic, singling out its opening jamming [3][5]
- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (1 review, 1 other source): Pigpen works the crowd hard in this Lovelight, which the reviewer finds outstanding; Gregg and Duane Allman joined the band during this song [2][11]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Reviewer hears very rough lead vocals from Jerry on this song [5]
- **Mama Tried** (1 review): Reviewer describes this performance as a bit of a trainwreck [8]
- **Casey Jones** (1 review): Very early version of the song, with a different intro and different instrumental sections [5]
- **The Eleven** (1 review): Reviewer says the start of The Eleven is really part of St. Stephen [10]

## The recordings

- **gd69-07-07.sbd.clugston.3116.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 8 songs; 113 min; rated 4.29/5 by 24 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the quality good apart from the feedback problem; Reviewer says the sound quality is not excellent but still listenable [3][4]
- **gd1969-07-07.123468.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 8 songs; 113 min; rated 3.78/5 by 9 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended as a one-year-old, riding on their father's shoulders for most of the show [6]
- Free thank-you concert from organizers of the first Atlanta Pop Festival, held a few days earlier [9]
- Delaney & Bonnie, Spirit and Chicago Transit Authority opened in the Piedmont Park picnic pavilion [9]
- Pigpen hobbled around with a cast on one leg [9]
- Reviewer was 15, attending the Atlanta festival and a party with the Dead the next day [14]
- Free concert in a city park, with the Allman Brothers also performing [2]
- Casey Jones is an early rough draft, only slightly better than the 6/22/69 version [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-07-07.sbd.clugston.3116.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Dark Star through Lovelight needs an 86-minute disc, so the Dark Star to St. Stephen disc break has no fades or overlaps [1]
- **gd1969-07-07.123468.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Ampex C-90) -> Dat (44.1k) [2]. Also: Tape flips occur at 19:39 in Dark Star and at 17:48 in Lovelight [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Piedmont Park - July 7, 1969](https://www.dead.net/show/july-7-1969) [16]
